semantics: getMoveScore multipliers for moves whose effect a field changes: boosted or weakened power, charge turns skipped or failing (Fly/Dig/Dive/Bounce/Phantom Force/Solar Beam/Razor Wind/Sky Attack/Meteor Beam/Electro Shot/Geomancy), recharge removed, eruptions and cave collapses, field-strengthened trapping, Aqua Ring/Ingrain/Wish/Floral Healing/Life Dew amounts, petrification, status spread, hazard conversion or failure (Wasteland, Water Surface, Electric/Crystal/Corrupted/fire/doubled rocks), weather moves on fields, and transitions rated neutral by getFieldDisruptScore (Flower Garden stages). Each named move has a rule in that field's definition (or acts through a generic field system such as residual damage); the rollout executes it and the strategy values the result through damage/HP, residual, lasting status/hazard/screen/slot-condition terms, the next-turn matchup, deferred strikes of charging moves, recharge cost and field valuation. The AI's numeric weights are replaced by these measurements. 2941 applies Swamp Ingrain damage although the source does it only outside Rejuvenation (Battle.rb:6351); the rollout follows the source.
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category
two-turn moves credit the measured pending strike unless the field skips the charge
Wish and Future Sight are valued from their slot conditions and recharge turns are priced
entry hazards are valued by their measured, field-modified effect on the opposing reserves
status and hazard benefits are priced beyond immediate damage
rollouts run the post-action Update event, so berries act between actions as in a real turn

semantics: hpGainPerTurn predicts end-of-turn HP from field damage and healing. Each rollout runs the simulator's residual events with the field engine; the residual term values the actual change. The prediction-versus-mechanic audit checks the predicted fractions on every named field; where the AI's estimate differs from Rejuvenation's own residual code (Corrosive ability damage on the wrong field, sleep damage counted twice, Dry Skin heal amount, Chlorophyll exemption) or from the documented Holy Salt Cure divisor decision, the strategy follows the shipped mechanic. 9259 subtracts Wildfire damage unconditionally in the source AI, whereas Battle.rb:7146 applies it only with the Wildfire ability; the rollout applies the real condition.
tests: AI end-of-turn HP predictions agree with the shipped residual mechanics

semantics: pbStatChangingSwitch(Opponent), quarkdriveCheck, pbFormChangeUponSwitchIn, pbAegislashStats and totalHazardDamage predict what happens when a Pokemon enters: field stat changes, Healing Wish/Lunar Dance boosts, paradox activation, forms and field-modified hazard damage. Switch, pivot, phazing and faint-replacement rollouts use the simulator's switchIn/runSwitch with the field engine, so these entry effects are measured; hazard values are measured the same way. The audit checks every predicted stage change; Quark Drive/Protosynthesis on New World/Desert and Mirror Armor on Colosseum are AI expectations that Rejuvenation's own entry code does not implement (Battler.rb:3417-3442, :2365 misspells MIRORARMOR), and the strategy follows the source.

semantics: pbStatChangingSwitch(Opponent), quarkdriveCheck, pbFormChangeUponSwitchIn, pbAegislashStats and totalHazardDamage predict what happens when a Pokemon enters: field stat changes, Healing Wish/Lunar Dance boosts, paradox activation, forms and field-modified hazard damage. semantics: Helper scores used by getMoveScore whose field branches describe real field mechanics: passive speed gains (Motor Drive/Steam Engine), perfect accuracy (Fairy Aura), Ice Face on Frozen Dimension, phazing failing on Colosseum and entry drops on dimensional fields, Flower Shield/Rototiller/Aromatic Mist boosts, Slow Start on Deep Earth, weather and terrain moves failing on fields, Competitive on Chess, Aurora Veil without hail, Glitch Hyper Beam and special stats, grounding, Serene Grace on Rainbow, Download on Dimensional, Lucky Chant/Amulet Coin, Back Alley Snatch and healing, field Wish/Salt Cure/Nightmare/Curse/Destiny Bond, Focus Punch on Electric Terrain, Telekinesis on Psychic Terrain, Iron Ball/Float Stone on Deep Earth, Recycle on Starlight, Raging Fury on Volcanic, Chess castling, hazard removal and one-hit KO immunity or perfect accuracy (Chess pawns, Colosseum Stalwart, Fairy Aura on Fairy Tale). The rollout executes the moves and abilities with the field engine and the outcome is valued by the same terms as other consequences (hazard removal through measured hazard impact).
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category

Sucker Punch and Upper Hand use actual queued choices; Upper Hand consumes effective field priority in the shared runtime, matching source Battle_MoveEffects.rb:9925.

semantics: Bounded opponent utility/protection/switch policy is measured through actual actions, queued in the simulator with all doubles actives. One plausible alternative is combined with the damaging reply, with accuracy/secondary weighting in both branches. This observes field status shields, speed control, spread protection, setup/Taunt and locked-attack switches. Sucker Punch and Upper Hand use actual queued choices; Upper Hand consumes effective field priority in the shared runtime, matching source Battle_MoveEffects.rb:9925.
